description: LTX-2.5 CUDA qualification matrix (#1398, #1414). Every row is one `mold run` against a scratch server whose environment matches `profile`; `expect.provenance` strings are the exact INFO log lines pinned by crates/mold-inference/src/ltx2/provenance_vocabulary.rs and `expect.metadata` keys are the additive saved-metadata fields it names.

placeholders.{seed_image}: PNG still extracted from the first frame of ltx-2.5-22b-distilled:int8-conv's passed smoke_silent_apng row (LTX25_SEED_IMAGE overrides)

kinds.render: one bounded `mold run`; passed requires exit 0, decoded media matching `expect`, a Library row, and every `expect.provenance` line in the retained server log slice
kinds.perf: a render at the production shape that additionally retains the scheduler_estimates row and the wall clock
kinds.cancellation: submit, cancel through `mold queue cancel` once denoise progress is observed, expect a terminal cancel with no Library row and GPU memory back at baseline
kinds.fatal_cuda: not_run unless LTX25_FATAL_CUDA_REPRO names a reproducer; evidence is the quarantine sentence in the server log
kinds.deferred: never attempted on this host; emitted as not_run with deferred_reason
